description: Search live Google web results for any query and country/language, returning ranked canonical organic results (position, title, direct URL, domain, snippet, favicon, sitelinks), native related_keywords array, People Also Ask (PAA) Q&A pairs, and Knowledge Graph. q.description: Search query string, e.g. "best vector database for rag 2026" or "site:sec.gov nvidia 10-k".
